none: PAS NLM-690841: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantius II from Rudston
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped cuirassed and diademed right, large ear. Legend off flan. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, identifying the ruler from his large ear.…
